items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 5:1
items.html: The stature of the coupling for the ten Sefirot of Nekudim came out in the openings of the eyes of SAG of AK, as above in answer 4, which is the upper one of the ten Sefirot of Nekudim. And it is known that the main part of the stature remains in the upper one, and the branch of that stature descends to the lower one. Therefore the stature of Nekudim that is in the upper one descended below the Tabur of the upper one and clothed there in its internality, and it is called the MA and BON of AK. And the stature of the lower one, which are the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, descended below the Tabur and clothed externally upon the TNHY of AK. (Items 6 and 2).
